hardGateFindings.finding: The candidate keeps every specimen within its supported scope: Open House is a ten-day communal practice Jamie tended; Time is Long is explicitly a realized installation; the network-and-image interface is explicitly a prototype; and the physical-room photograph concept is explicitly a co-designed documented proposal. The first-person phrases “My operating practice” and “The same inquiry continues” correctly mark cross-period continuity as Jamie’s interpretation rather than a claim or quotation attributed to Morse or Sack.

The candidate exposes no educational record, grade, student identifier, correspondence, contact detail, image, private locator, or participant identity. It uses only bounded public-safe summaries of the works and does not present protected evaluations or recommendation material as public artifacts.

The phrase “with value beyond organizational utility” expressly preserves the artistic and relational work as valuable beyond employment or operational outcomes, while the later-practice connection remains interpretive rather than instrumental.

Jamie’s role is specific but bounded through “I tended” and “I also prototyped.” “Communal,” “participation,” “co-designed,” and the closing emphasis on people and relationships preserve shared inhabitation, participant presence, and collaborator agency without assigning Jamie sole authorship of Open House or the documented proposal.

dimensionFindings.finding: The candidate treats inhabitation and bodily encounter as inquiry: Open House is communal and tended, Time is Long makes elapsed time physical, and the proposal makes photograph browsing occur through movement across physical rooms. These are framed as experiments in attention, atmosphere, participation, representation, and care rather than as illustrations subordinate to prose.

“A ten-day communal Open House I tended” makes sustained presence and the duration of care explicit. The accompanying language of atmosphere, participation, care, people, relationships, and place makes the conditions of shared participation substantive rather than decorative.

The passage supplies a ten-day duration, a realized installation translating elapsed time into physical experience, an interface prototype joining network analysis with image comparison, and a documented proposal translating online photographs into movement through rooms. Crucially, the revision now distinguishes the realized installation, interface prototype, and co-designed proposal as separate maturity states.

The first-person artistic-lineage framing connects the bounded early specimens with civic, technical, and organizational practice through “The same inquiry continues.” It presents continuity of inquiry and form—not a claim that the courses or artworks simply caused every later project—so the interpretation boundary remains intact.

A general reader can follow the professional relevance through the explicit civic, technical, and organizational connection, while “value beyond organizational utility” and the emphasis on attention, atmosphere, participation, representation, care, relationships, and place keep the artistic and relational value irreducible to hiring utility.

limitations: The review is confined to public-safe repository records; protected source summaries were treated only as bounded corroboration, not as public artifacts.
